name: insurance-tabular-review
description: Standalone handoff kit for an insurance tabular review product: template catalog package, implementation spec, and clickable demo.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/review-templates && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/review-templates && npm test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/review-templates && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/review-templates && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w web"
